verdict.rationale: Snyk has a confirmed live llms.txt at docs.snyk.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200, returned actual index of docs) that an agent could be pointed at, plus extensive agent-oriented docs on MCP server, agentic remediation, and slash commands for coding assistants. Missing for 10: no evidence of dedicated 'agent-friendly' navigation structure beyond the llms.txt file itself, and no independent confirmation that agents reliably parse it well in practice.
